articles.desc: To improve carbon recycling and reduce emissions, researchers at Science Tokyo developed iron-substituted calcium titanate (Fe-doped CaTiO3) as an environmentally friendly support material for chemical looping, a process that converts carbon dioxide (CO2) into carbon monoxide for fuel and chemical production. articles.title: Twisted laser light distinguishes mirror-image molecules by their fragment counts
